summary: Why a moving platform is paused: a bit mask maintained by esv::platform::MovementSystem::ProcessPlatformPauseReasons (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x648850), which ORs in bit 1 and bit 2 for different conditions (combat / turn-based checks of the queried components) and tests them. Seen.py context: trigger S_UND_KethericCity_Firewall_EventTrigger_2 and a trader scene.

fields.evidence: ProcessPlatformPauseReasons: *(ulonglong*)(x) = *(ulonglong*)(x) | 1 and *puVar22 | 2, and tests (byte & 1) / (byte >> 1 & 1) on the 8-byte-stride component storage. macOS default ctor zeroes one qword. Live 1.
